testcase.name: Scenario: Change the wheel tool-tip preference: tmp/obk-wheel-3945-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:157:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change the wheel tool-tip preference ✔ Given the full navigation wheel is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And Show Tool Tips is enabled in wheel options ✔ When the user opens wheel options and clear Show Tool Tips ✔ And the user clicks OK ✔ Then the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible ✔ When the user reopens wheel options ✔ Then Show Tool Tips is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Show Tool Tips and clicks OK ✔ Then the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
